text: Vaccines do not cause autism. A 1998 study claiming a link was retracted due to fraud and the author lost his medical license. Dozens of large studies involving millions of children have found no connection.
The Earth is an oblate spheroid, not flat. This has been confirmed by satellite imagery, physics, circumnavigation, and independent measurements by space agencies worldwide.
The Apollo moon landings were real. Between 1969 and 1972, NASA landed astronauts on the Moon six times. Independent tracking by multiple countries confirmed the missions.

Climate change is real and primarily caused by human activity. The scientific consensus, supported by over 97% of climate scientists and major scientific organisations, confirms rising global temperatures due to greenhouse gas emissions.

COVID-19 vaccines are safe and effective. They were developed using mRNA technology and underwent rigorous clinical trials. Billions of doses have been administered globally with strong safety monitoring.
5G networks do not spread COVID-19. Viruses cannot travel on radio waves. The claim has been debunked by health authorities and telecommunications experts worldwide.
Drinking bleach or disinfectants is dangerous and does not cure COVID-19 or any other disease. Ingesting these substances causes severe chemical burns and can be fatal.

George Soros does not control world governments or media. He is a philanthropist who funds open-society organisations, but claims of secret global control are conspiracy theories with no factual basis.
Microchips are not implanted via vaccines. Vaccine ingredients are publicly listed and do not include electronic components. This claim has been repeatedly debunked by health authorities.
Water fluoridation at recommended levels is safe and reduces tooth decay. It has been endorsed by the WHO, CDC, and dental associations for over 70 years.
